paper_title: Can We Edit LLMs for Long-Tail Biomedical Knowledge
caption: : The performance on BioGPT.

annotations.annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%), comparing various methods represented by different lines. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number", has a exponential scale, and the values range from 10 to 1000 with tick labels at intervals of 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 30 to 55, with tick labels at intervals of 5 units. The plot displays six lines: a black solid line with circular markers representing "Base" starts at approximately 28% at 5 and ends at about 33% bit beyond 10^3; a blue dashed line with downward triangular markers representing "FT" begins near 32% at 5 and rises to around 38% bit beyond 10^3; a red solid line with upward triangular markers indicating "IKE" starts at about 32% at 5 and ends around 41% bit beyond 10^3; a brown line with diamond markers representing "MEND" starts near 36% at 5 and concludes at 45% bit beyond 10^3; a purple line with pentagon markers for "MEMIT" begins at about 36% at 5 and reaches approximately 46% bit beyond 10^3; and a green line with square markers depicting "ROME" starts around 44% at 5 and climbs to nearly 59% bit beyond 10^3. The trends indicate steady increases across the x-axis for all lines. There are 4 markers in each line. A legend is given in top left, describing the lines and color.
